## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code and stays small (no new dependencies without discussion)
- [ ] If an endpoint or MCP tool changed: `README.md`, `llms.txt`, `openapi.json`, `src/client.ts`, `src/mcp-server.ts` and `examples/` all updated
- [ ] No real tokens in code, examples, logs or screenshots
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
